# Plan NNNN: scope title

## Specification

Requirement IDs, problem, observable behavior, acceptance criteria, affected contracts, and explicit scope boundaries.

## Strategy

Component changes, reusable utilities considered, integration boundaries, data flow, error/cancellation behavior, compatibility, and rollback/reversibility.

## Checklist

- [ ] Clean named branch and reviewed starting state.
- [ ] Specifications and relevant ADRs updated.
- [ ] Ordered implementation steps and acceptance strategy recorded.
- [ ] Executable BDD feature fails for intended behavior; command and result recorded.
- [ ] Logical step 1: failing test, minimal implementation, green, refactor.
- [ ] Additional logical steps: repeat red/green until BDD passes.
- [ ] Formatting, lint/static analysis, and all project tests pass.
- [ ] Project/user docs updated and checked against implementation.
- [ ] Diff, dependencies, and applicable platform evidence reviewed.
- [ ] Meaningful commit created; all scoped work committed; branch clean.

## Validation evidence

Record actual commands, red failure reasons, green results, platform/toolchain details, and checks not run with reasons. Do not label planned tests as passed.

## Risks and open decisions

Unresolved compatibility, performance, behavior, security, and distribution questions; identify which must be resolved before acceptance.
